title: Pulse style pack and extra widget areas

entries.summary: Areas header, after_header, home, sidebar, after_content, footer. Types featured_posts, cta, pages, social. installStarterIfEmpty fills empty areas only.
Bundled Pulse pack seeds header/home widgets. Activate calls Widget::installStarterIfEmpty. Download ?pack=pulse.
Widgets remain cms_widgets rows in the SQL dump. Pulse starter widgets restore with that table. Pack CSS is still uploads + app_settings.
